title: Analytics
description: Cost, usage, latency, success and feedback for your agents and workflows, with alarms and custom metrics.
projectDescription: Cost, usage, latency, quality and evals for this project, from its real runs.

filters.label: Filters
filters.invalidRange: The start date must be on or before the end date.

kpis.noPrevious: No data for the previous period
kpis.errors: {count, plural, =0 {No errors} one {# failed} other {# failed}}
kpis.terminal: {count, plural, =0 {None finished} one {Of # finished} other {Of # finished}}

breakdown.title: Breakdown
breakdown.description: The same metrics by dimension, with the filters applied.
breakdown.emptyDescription: No runs match these filters in the period.

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.description: Thumbs up or down from users, with their comments.
feedback.emptyDescription: When users rate answers in the chat or the API, they will show up here.

empty.title: No runs yet
empty.description: Once your agents and workflows run, you will see their cost, usage, latency and quality here.
empty.filteredDescription: Widen the period or remove a filter.

evals.title: Evals by version
evals.description: Pass rate of each case across the latest versions of the agent or workflow.
evals.runsCount: {count, plural, one {# eval run} other {# eval runs}}
evals.inferred: * Manual evals attributed to the latest version saved at that time.
evals.legend: Each cell shows passed over run cases. Green: all passed; amber: some; red: none. * inferred version.
evals.noMembersTitle: This project has no agents or workflows
evals.noMembersDescription: Create an agent and add evals to compare versions.
evals.emptyDescription: Run the evals from the editor or deploy a version to see the comparison.

alarms.title: Alarms
alarms.description: Thresholds on errors, latency, cost or custom metrics. They are evaluated every minute and alert admins in the app, by email or on Slack.
alarms.formDescription: The alarm fires when the metric, computed over the window, meets the condition.
alarms.windowHint: Period the metric is computed over.
alarms.inAppAlways: Admins always get an in-app notification.
alarms.slackNotConnected: There is no active Slack connection: Slack alerts will be skipped until you connect it.
alarms.historyDescription: Alarm state changes and the alerts sent.
alarms.historyEmptyDescription: The alarm has not fired yet.

delivery.inApp: {count, plural, one {# in-app notice} other {# in-app notices}}

reasons.provider_error: Slack rejected the message (does the channel exist?)

testErrors.unknown_metric: The alarm's metric no longer exists.
testErrors.invalid_metric: The metric definition is not valid.

alarms.testBreached: “{name}”: current value {value}. The condition is met: the alarm would fire.
alarms.testOk: “{name}”: current value {value}. The condition is not met.
alarms.firingBanner: {count, plural, one {# alarm firing} other {# alarms firing}}
alarms.firingBannerHint: Check their history and the analytics to see what changed.
alarms.emptyDescription: Create an alarm to hear about error, latency or cost spikes before your users do.
alarms.footnote: Alarms are evaluated every minute. Alerts are only sent when the state changes (fired or resolved).
alarms.deleteDescription: Its history is deleted too. This action is audited.

metrics.title: Custom metrics
metrics.description: Define metrics over traces (model calls, tools, steps) or over runs, and use them in charts and alarms.
metrics.formDescription: Choose what to count or measure and filter the traces included.

sourceHints.spans: Every model call, tool call or step.
sourceHints.runs: Every complete run of an agent or workflow.

metrics.previewIncomplete: Complete the definition to see the preview.
metrics.previewError: The metric cannot be computed with this definition.
metrics.emptyDescription: For example: failed calls to the invoices tool, or a model's 95th percentile duration.
metrics.deleteInUse: {count, plural, one {# alarm uses it: delete or change it first.} other {# alarms use it: delete or change them first.}}

policy.description: Which models the organization may use. The model gateway enforces the policy on every call from agents, workflows and platform features.

allow.title: Allowed
allow.description: If you add patterns, only matching models are allowed.
allow.empty: No allow list: every model that is not blocked is allowed.

deny.title: Blocked
deny.description: Matching models are always blocked, even if allowed.

errors.invalid_glob: Use the provider/model format with * or ? wildcards (e.g. anthropic/claude-*).
errors.blocks_everything: The policy would block every model: no agent could run.

policy.readOnly: Only admins can change the model policy.
policy.tierWarning: Agents configured with the {tiers} tier will not run until you change their model.
policy.roleWarning: Guard uses a blocked model: agents with Guard enabled will fail.
policy.footnote: Changes apply within seconds in every environment.
policy.resetDescription: The allow and block lists will be removed. This action is audited.
